items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: me and Kingfish were behind the bar

ctx.x: So we had about fifteen...sixteen waitresses. We had a big floorshow. Everything was jumpin'. I was still a runner and tendin' bar. I get up and sing and come back down and get behind the bar and tend to my business. We had a lot of waitresses there...had three bartenders--Kingfish...I forget this other fellow's name in there... [ ] I should never forget him because he was master. He worked downtown in all the big hotels, and he knowed how to mix all the different kind o' drinks, an' he was a...a connoisseur...of…
